title: UX/UI Designer – Fleet Command & Robot Management

fields.duties:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
We’re building the command layer for a new generation of intelligent robots.
As our first UX/UI design hire, you will define how humans command, deploy, and collaborate with autonomous systems in the physical world. You will own the experience for fleet command of distributed, sensor-equipped robotic systems operating in real environments. This is mission-critical software that enables non-experts to operate intelligent machines, not a fleet dashboard with status icons. Customers will rely on what you design to monitor, deploy, coordinate, and intervene across their robot installations.
Beyond fleet command, you will architect a radically simplified deployment experience: a true “unbox, power on, connect, deploy” journey via app or tablet. Our ambition is to eliminate heavy pilots and prolonged engagements by making robot activation intuitive, guided, and production-ready from day one.
This is a zero-to-one role with expanding scope. You will set the design standard for the company and establish deployment and command UX as a strategic advantage for Skild AI.
Responsibilities
Own UX/UI from concept through production.
Translate complex robotics and AI capabilities into simplified, controllable systems.
Design production workflows for distributed, moving, sensor-equipped assets.
Lead customer interviews, usability studies, and rapidly prototyping.
Raise the design craft, rigor, and systems-thinking bar across the applied AI team.
End-to-end UX for fleet monitoring and control
AI-assisted control surfaces (configure, automate, supervise, escalate)
Self-service onboarding and training workflows
Real-time telemetry and multimodal sensor visualization (camera + beyond)
Alerting, incident response, and system health management
Task orchestration and multi-robot coordination
Preferred Qualifications
2-4 years designing exceptional consumer hardware experiences and/or complex B2B operational systems.
Proven experience building production workflows for distributed systems or moving assets.
Strong background in data-heavy, real-time operational tools.
Experience with monitoring, alerting, and multi-state workflows.
Experience designing interfaces integrating multimodal data.
Demonstrated systems thinking and high design craft.
Comfort leading customer research and translating insight into product decisions.
Bonus
Robotics, autonomous systems, security, or industrial experience.
Experience designing control system consoles.
Experience simplifying complex hardware setup flows.
Familiarity with AI-assisted configuration and automation interfaces.
Base Salary Range
$100,000
—
$300,000 USD

title: 工业设计师（数采穿戴产品方向）

fields.duties:
1.穿戴类产品工业设计，独立开展市场调研、竞品分析、用户需求分析，输出设计策略、概念草图、造型方案；协同人因完成穿戴设计优化及测评；参与原型设计开发
2.独立完成曲面建模、渲染、CMF 色彩材质工艺设计，输出效果图、设计提案；
对接结构、电控、硬件团队，协调传感器布局、散热、防水、布线、IP 等级、安规等设计约束；
4.熟悉注塑、钣金、压铸、3D 打印等工艺，跟进手板、打样、试产，解决落地问题；
5.参与构建统一品牌设计语言；
fields.requirements:
1.5年以上工作经验，3年以上穿戴类等复杂产品设计经验；
2.精通 Rhino(SUBD)/Alias/CERO 建模，Keyshot/Octane 渲染，PS/AI 排版；
3.懂机械基础、结构常识，能看懂结构图纸，具备工程落地思维；
4.熟悉 CMF 设计、各类表面处理工艺，了解 IP 防护、安规、散热基本要求；
5.沟通能力强，抗压，重视细节，动手能力
加分项：blender、动画制作，国际奖项；

1.负责产品包装全案设计，包括盒型结构、外观视觉、品牌视觉、材质工艺、标签、说明书、外箱等整体包装体系设计。
2.依据品牌调性、产品定位、市场竞品分析，输出包装创意方案、手绘草图、效果图、落地文件。
3.独立完成包装平面设计、排版、色彩规范、字体设计、信息层级优化，确保符合品牌 VI。
4.熟悉包装材质与工艺：卡纸、瓦楞、烫金、UV、逆向、击凸、覆膜、模切、特殊纸、塑料包装等，能输出可直接印刷的规范文件。
5.与供应链、印刷厂、结构工程师对接，跟进打样、色彩校准、工艺落地、量产验收。
6.负责包装合规检查：文案、条码、标准号、生产信息、法规要求、电商平台规范等。
7.优化包装成本、运输安全性、展示效果、用户拆箱体验。

fields.duties:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
We're looking for a Senior Robot Animator to help bring our robots to life. In this role, you'll work closely with our robotics, simulation, and hardware teams to rig, animate, and refine motion that runs both in simulation and on physical machines, supporting a range of teams and programs across the company. This is an animation-first role focused on the computer graphics side of motion — rigging, keyframe animation, body mechanics, and the editing and retargeting of captured data. Strong candidates pair animation craft with an intuition for what a physical robot can actually execute.
Responsibilities
Author robot motion in Maya (or Blender) using keyframe, procedural, and capture-based techniques
Work with our robotics engineers to take motion from digital content creation (DCC) to real hardware
Choreograph and time performances, including multi-robot sequences and motion cut to music or camera
Deliver finished rendered work as well as sequences performed by the machines themselves
Build motion libraries and retargeting that support our simulation and machine learning work
Partner with our hardware teams on previz and range-of-motion studies that inform design
Preferred Qualifications
5+ years animating professionally in film/VFX, games, or robotics, or equivalent senior-level experience — demo reel required
Expert keyframe animation with a strong sense of weight, timing, and body mechanics
Rigging experience with mechanical or articulated characters: constraints, IK/FK, joint limits, mechanism-accurate setups
Comfortable cleaning, editing, and retargeting motion capture onto non-human skeletons
Background working with humanoid or robotic characters in simulation or the real world
Familiarity with controls/rigid-body dynamics/simulation is a plus
Base Salary Range
$100,000
—
$300,000 USD
